faq.a: No. The logo maker runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript and SVG. Your business name and design choices are never uploaded, stored, or sent anywhere.
faq.q: Is my logo data sent to a server?

faq.a: Yes. Download PNG gives you a raster image (1200 × 800) for websites and social profiles; Download SVG gives you a vector file you can scale to any size without losing quality.
faq.q: Can I download my logo as a PNG and as an SVG?

faq.a: This tool creates a simple wordmark-style logo from shapes, colours and text. For a fully custom illustrated mark or a registered trademark, work with a professional designer.
faq.q: Is this a full brand identity tool?

heroSubtitle: Design a simple, clean logo for your business — pick a layout, colours and icon, then download it.
metaDescription: Free logo maker: design a simple business logo online with layouts, colour palettes and icons. Download PNG or SVG — runs entirely in your browser.
title: Logo Maker — Design a Free Business Logo Online | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: Don't use a simple shape-based logo where a distinctive, trademarkable brand mark matters — a designer-built mark is the safer choice there.
If you need a logo with a photo, a detailed illustration or custom lettering, this tool's shapes and text styles won't cover it.
